description:
Implement comprehensive DDL generation for Amazon Redshift with support for
its unique physical tuning capabilities.

## Redshift Physical Tuning Features

### Distribution Styles (DISTSTYLE)
- **ALL**: Entire table copied to every node (small dimension tables)
- **KEY**: Rows distributed by hash of DISTKEY column (fact tables)
- **EVEN**: Round-robin distribution (default, no join colocation)
- **AUTO**: Redshift chooses based on data size

### Distribution Key (DISTKEY)
- Single column for hash distribution
- Critical for join performance (colocate related rows)
- Should match JOIN columns between fact and dimension tables

### Sort Keys (SORTKEY)
- **COMPOUND**: Columns sorted in order specified (default)
  - Best for queries with range conditions on leading column
  - Best for ORDER BY matching the sort key
- **INTERLEAVED**: Equal weight to each column
  - Best for queries filtering on any subset of columns
  - Higher load/vacuum overhead
- Up to 400 columns in sort key

### Column Encoding (ENCODE)
- Per-column compression algorithm
- Options: RAW, AZ64, BYTEDICT, DELTA, DELTA32K, LZO, MOSTLY8/16/32,
  RUNLENGTH, TEXT255, TEXT32K, ZSTD
- AUTO encoding recommended for most cases

## Current Gap

Redshift adapter (`benchbox/platforms/redshift.py`) has:
- `generate_tuning_clause()` method (line ~1936)
- Reads partitioning/sorting columns from tuning config
- BUT: Only logs tuning info, doesn't generate DISTSTYLE/SORTKEY DDL
